name: YITAMOTOR Towing Mirror Compatible with 2008-2016 Ford F250 F350 F450 F550 Super Duty, Right Passenger Side Mirror Power Heated Telescoping Folding Turn Signal Light Black
fitment:
Fit for 2008-2016 Ford F250 Super Duty
Fit for 2008-2016 Ford F350 Super Duty
Fit for 2008-2016 Ford F450 Super Duty
Fit for 2008-2016 Ford F550 Super Duty
(Notes：22 Heads 7 Pins Connector, the temperature sensor is not included)
Professional installation would be highly recommended
Feature
Fitment: compatible with 2008-2016 Ford F250 F350 F450 F550 Super Duty
Package contents & dimensions: the right passenger side mirror, side mirror length is 18.5” (closed) and 21.65” (extended); side mirror size is 12”×9.17”
Functions: featuring power adjustable & power heated plane mirror, manually adjustable convex lens, halogen lights, manual telescoping, manual folding & manual extension arm, the multifunctional side mirrors can strikingly enhance your driving experience
Easy to install: just simply connect the plugs of the trailer towing mirror to the corresponding power cord, no drilling or modifications required（professional installation would be highly recommended）
Note: please check if your vehicle has the same functions as that of towing mirrors, such as turn signal, otherwise some functions of towing mirrors will be disabled when the vehicle does not possess the corresponding functions
Temperature Sensor is NOT Included.
